sources.snippet: Overview distilbert-base-multilingual-cased is a compressed version of BERT base multilingual cased created by distilbert. This transformer-based language model supports 104 languages trained on Wikipedia data and delivers approximately twice the inference speed of the full multilingual BERT while using only 134M parameters instead of 177M.
